name: El-Abar
description: The site of Najib's castle, reduced to rubble by dwarves.

description_citations.text: Eighth Edition: card flavor text (Eighth Edition, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Najib retreats to his castle at El-Abar and is found dead the next morning.
timeline.quote: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead.

citation.text: Dwarven Demolition Team (Limited Edition Alpha, 1993), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dwarven forces reduce the walls of Najib's castle to rubble in one night.
timeline.quote: In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

citation.text: Dwarven Demolition Team (Limited Edition Alpha, 1993), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
